title.zh: 经络诊察：审、切、循、扪、按，异常反应与它们的含义
title.en: Channel Examination: Inspect, Press, Trace, Palpate, Push, and What the Abnormal Reactions Mean

summary.zh: 经络诊察是他在《内经》理论下总结的物理诊断法：以审、切、循、扪、按收集经络的客观反应（结节、结络、结块、脆络、滞涩、凹陷、隆起等），并规范了望诊范围、切诊路线、体位和手法。发现的异常经脉不一定是当下病症的经脉，必须再与症候对接。
summary.en: Channel examination is the physical diagnostic method he distilled under Neijing theory: inspecting, pressing, tracing, palpating and pushing to collect objective channel reactions (nodules, node-collaterals, lumps, brittle collaterals, sluggishness, hollows, bulges), with standardised inspection field, palpation routes, posture and hand method. The abnormal channels found need not be the channel of the present complaint and must be matched with the symptoms.

takeaways.zh: 经络诊察是一套规定好的物理诊断：审、切、循、扪、按，取得经络的客观反应，较准确地掌握经络功能状态；常见反应有结节、结络、结块、脆络、滞涩、凹陷、隆起、水泡、气泡。他把《内经》中零散的内容整理成规范方法：望诊范围、切诊路线、不同经脉切诊时患者的体位与医者手法，以及各经各穴常见的异常。
takeaways.en: Examination is a prescribed physical diagnosis: inspect, press, trace, palpate and push to collect objective channel reactions and judge functional state; usual reactions are nodule, node-collateral, lump, brittle collateral, sluggishness, hollow, bulge, blister, bubble. He gathered the scattered Neijing material into a standard method: inspection field, palpation routes, patient posture and hand method for each channel, and the usual abnormalities of each channel and point.

takeaways.zh: 察到的异常经脉不等于当下病症的经脉：经络会记住既往病症并留下印记，也会在症状未出现时先有反应；所以异常经络要再与症候对接才成“病经”。在他的案例里，三阴三阳里被察出异常的经与最后所选的经，只有约四分之一完全相同（91案中22案），多数案例二者并不等同。
takeaways.en: An abnormal channel found is not automatically the channel of the present illness: channels remember past illness and show changes before symptoms appear, so the abnormal channels must still be matched with the symptoms to become the "disease channels". In his cases only about a quarter (22 of 91) have exactly the same set of six-channel abnormalities as the channels finally chosen.

takeaways.zh: 每一个发现都要“解读”，他在括号里把所见对应到症状或脏腑：案7右孔最深部结络对慢性气管病变，中府下结络对肺病(也可能与吸烟史有关)，督脉4、5椎结络对气管；案83温溜结节对胃灼热、打嗝和慢性食道炎；案39神门硬结络对心律不齐。
takeaways.en: Every finding is "read": in brackets he ties what he feels to a symptom or organ: case 7, a deep node-collateral at right Kongzui for chronic airway disease, one below Zhongfu for lung disease (possibly linked to smoking), one at du T4-5 for the trachea; case 83, a nodule at Wenliu for heartburn, belching and chronic oesophagitis; case 39, a hard node-collateral at Shenmen for arrhythmia.

takeaways.zh: “没有异常”本身也是信息：案102左尺泽下有结节、凹陷，但手少阴经无异常，他据此说明不是心脏病变；案16里选上脘还是中脘，最终由按压时有无压痛、发硬、松软塌陷、肠鸣来定。
takeaways.en: Absence of abnormality is also information: in case 102 nodules and a hollow below left Chize but a normal hand shaoyin channel let him say the chest pain was not cardiac; in case 16 whether to use Shangwan or Zhongwan is finally decided by pressing for tenderness, hardness, soft collapse or gurgling.

takeaways.zh: 心包经与心经的察经所见不同：他在眉冲一文中写，心肌缺血的病人常在心包经查到异常反应，一般是局部肌肉紧张度增高；心律不齐的病人则常在心经循摸出异常。这来自察经，而不是先有理论再套穴。
takeaways.en: Pericardium and heart channels show different findings: in the Meichong essay he writes that in patients with myocardial ischaemia examination often finds abnormal reactions on the pericardium channel, generally raised local muscle tension, whereas in arrhythmia abnormalities are often felt on the heart channel. This comes from examination, not from theory applied to points afterwards.

takeaways.zh: 察经的结果直接决定用不用某个穴或某个部位：左通天处指下松软或僵硬、或按压酸痛，才用搓针法治久咳；同名经对应取穴时，若对应部位摸不到反应，就不必治疗，因为不会有效；他又要求循摸穴位时医生手感与病人的感觉相一致，而不能只靠病人说酸痛。
takeaways.en: The examination result decides whether a point or site is used at all: only when Left Tongtian feels soft or stiff under the finger, or is sore on pressure, does he use the rubbing-needle method for chronic cough; in same-name corresponding-point treatment, if no reaction is found at the corresponding site it should not be treated because it will not work; and when palpating a point the physician's finger feel should agree with the patient's sensation, not rely on the patient's soreness alone.

takeaways.zh: 察的层次不同，处理不同：经筋的筋结在肌肉起止点重按能摸到结块、结节、结络、脆络，用结筋法；络脉的“异常络脉”部位很浅，形细小，色鲜红、紫或黑，用三棱针放血(如委中下紫色浮络放出黑血数滴即愈)。
takeaways.en: What is felt at different layers is handled differently: sinew-channel knots are found by pressing at muscle origins and insertions (lumps, nodules, node-collaterals, brittle collaterals) and treated by the sinew-binding method; collateral abnormalities are very superficial, fine, bright red, purple or black, and are pricked with a three-edged needle (a purple floating vessel below Weizhong bled a few drops of black blood and the leg pain was cured).

takeaways.zh: 察经使同一病得到不同的选经：四例周围性面瘫，分别以太阳经、少阳经与阳明经等不同经脉异常为主；皮肤病虽常取太阴经，他也强调不能误以为一切皮肤病都取太阴，仍须经络诊察识别后再选。
takeaways.en: Examination gives different channel choices for the same disease: four cases of peripheral facial palsy had different dominant abnormal channels (taiyang, shaoyang, yangming); and although skin disease often involves taiyin he warns against assuming every skin disease takes taiyin points, which must still be identified by examination.

how_to_use.zh: 读案时先看“经络诊察”一栏括号里的话：他把每个所见对到一个症状或脏腑，这是他“解读”察经的方式。再看被察出的经与最终选的经是否一致，不一致时看他为什么改选(症候、表里、同名、局部)。要学的是“摸到什么—意味着什么—怎么处理”，不是套用某个穴。具体选经见 wjy-04，选穴与循摸见 wjy-05。
how_to_use.en: When reading a case, look first at the brackets in the examination line: each finding is tied to a symptom or organ, which is how he "reads" the channels. Then compare the channels found with those finally chosen and see why they differ (symptoms, exterior-interior, same-name, local). Learn "what is felt, what it means, what to do", not a point recipe. Channel choice: wjy-04; point choice and palpation: wjy-05.

caveats.zh: 本表中的“所见→解读”是他在括号或解读里写下的对应，不是可套用的诊断标准；隆起、水泡、气泡在书中只被列名。统计根据案例栏目自动解析，案例中OCR残缺处(如“阴经”应为厥阴经)已按厥阴处理，数字为近似值。
caveats.en: The "finding → reading" pairs are what he wrote in brackets or commentary, not diagnostic standards to apply; bulge, blister and bubble are only listed. Counts are parsed from the case fields, garbled OCR ("阴经" for jueyin) read as jueyin, so numbers are approximate.
